metadata.case_name: MA SHUN HUNG v. CHUN WAI HK HOLDINGS LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Director and shareholder of Grandly Enterprise Limited; employed by the same company as a sales manager

injuries.description: soft tissue injury in his lower back as a result of the accident with damage to the muscles and the ligaments.
source: both the Plaintiffs and the Defendants medical experts agree that the Plaintiff has suffered soft tissue injury in his lower back as a result of the accident with damage to the muscles and the ligaments.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: mild degenerative changes in the Plaintiffs lumbo-sacral spine which are not caused by the accident.
source: There are mild degenerative changes in the Plaintiffs lumbo-sacral spine which are not caused by the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Residual intermittent pain in his lower back occurring about once every 1 to 2 weeks.
Pain intensifies when the Plaintiff stands or walks for a longer period of time or carries heavy object.
Unable to lift heavy objects, affecting daily activities including the enjoyment of sporting activities.
Recommendation of 3 days of sick leave after A&E attendance; treated and discharged same day.

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital; treated and discharged same day
physiotherapy treatment (referred to Kowloon Hospital; attended until 10 September 2005 then defaulted)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cannot lift heavy objects which would in turn affect his daily activities including the enjoyment of sporting activities.
